definitions.explanation: A breeze or wind that blows at night. Often evokes a cool, pleasant, or atmospheric feeling.

examples.japanese: {夜風|よかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
{夜風|よかぜ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たり→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}した→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk in the night breeze.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧{夜風|よかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧きた。
examples.english: When I opened the window, a cool night breeze came into the room.

notes:
Compound of {夜|よ} (night) + ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (wind, breeze). A poetic and evocative word frequently found in literature, song lyrics, and seasonal descriptions.

USAGE:
Often appears with verbs like ⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (to be exposed to) and ⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ (to blow). Carries a literary or atmospheric tone, evoking scenes of quiet nighttime moments. Especially associated with summer evenings when the night air brings welcome relief from daytime heat.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夜風|よかぜ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ — to feel the night breeze
- {夜風|よかぜ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{吹|ふ}く→吹く：02445_fuku⟧ — the night breeze blows
- ⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧{夜風|よかぜ} — cool night breeze
- ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧{夜風|よかぜ} — cold night wind

SIMILAR WORDS:
- そよ{風|かぜ} — gentle breeze (not time-specific)
- {朝風|あさかぜ} — morning breeze
- {涼風|りょうふう}/すずかぜ — cool breeze (not time-specific)
